name: Chiruhana ~Kindan no Ketsuzoku~
source:
Our guy went to his fiance's house to help out after her father got murdered. It seems either this house has a curse or someone is on a killing spree. His detective friend comes to help find what's going on. You get to view how this sad story turn out through our guy and his fiance's sister's eyes.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
